title: Code Mode execution request
description: The params of the broker action codemode.execute: one program the runner runs in the sandbox. The actor and the time are the enclosing broker request's, never params, so a program runs as the profile the broker authenticated. resume: true continues the paused execution of the same execution_id: the runner refuses it unless that execution exists, belongs to the same actor and has the same code digest (sha256 of the canonical JSON of {language, code}), and then replays completed steps from the journal. A request without resume whose execution_id already exists is refused, so two runs never share a journal. Absent budget caps take the runner's defaults; the runner may lower a cap, never raise it above these maxima.
